blocks.md: **White=unseen, Gray=on current DFS path, Black=finished. Gray-meets-gray edge = directed cycle.**

blocks.label: directed cycle via color array
blocks.py:
# color: 0 white, 1 gray(on path), 2 black(done)
def dfs(v):
    color[v] = 1
    for u in adj[v]:
        if color[u] == 1: return True     # back-edge = CYCLE
        if color[u] == 0 and dfs(u): return True
    color[v] = 2
    return False

blocks.label: Rotten Oranges (LC994) minutes counter
blocks.py:
from collections import deque
q = deque(rotten_cells)             # MULTI-source seed
fresh = count_fresh()
minutes = 0
while q and fresh > 0:
    minutes += 1
    for _ in range(len(q)):         # one wave
        r, c = q.popleft()
        for dr, dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
            if is_fresh(nr, nc):
                rot(nr, nc); fresh -= 1; q.append((nr, nc))
return -1 if fresh else minutes
